body.x: Curaum introduced an oral device for measuring sleep apnea at CES 2022, which was held in Las Vegas from January 5 to 7.

Curaum is a healthcare company specializing in dental and sleep-related fields. Curaum's products and services utilize new and advanced technologies to collect and analyze consumers' medical, healthcare, and sleep data to monitor hygiene, and diagnose and predict signs of disease.

body.cap: Curaum representative at CES 2022 introducing an oral device for measuring sleep apnea. │Source - Aving News

body.x: Curaum seeks to improve the quality of everyday life by treating and managing chronic diseases related to oral hygiene and sleep, through technological developments.

Curaum operates a healthcare brand called Clium for oral health. Clium products clean, sterilize, and manage devices and various oral hygiene products contaminated with harmful substances in everyday life in a smart and safe way that combines IoMT technology.

Clium Oralog, a customized sleep device that helps you sleep deeply and comfortably, is a sensory mandibular omnidirectional device for the management and treatment of obstructive sleep apnea and snoring symptoms. Wearing the device moves the lower jaw forward during sleep and opens the airway to relieve sleep apnea symptoms. At the same time, various sensors built into the device record bio-signals sent by the body during sleep to provide information that can effectively manage and treat chronic sleep diseases.

Meanwhile, Curaum participated in CES 2022 as part of the Biohealth Innovation Startup Center's Startup Leap Package support project. The Korea Health Industry Development Institute's Biohealth Innovation Startup Center opened in March 2018 in order to encourage more startup and revitalize the ecosystem. Excellent ideas and technologies are discovered, and dedicated project managers (PMs) are deployed to provide support in professional consulting, technical evaluation, investment attraction, and market support.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition where you can grasp the flow of the global home appliance industry at a glance. It is hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS, which has been covering CES for 16 consecutive years, has been sending the most news around the world every year since 2006, and will host ‘Best of CES 2022’ to select the best innovative products and technologies and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA’ to select notable Korean companies.
